answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the tundra queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The dawn index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1425 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the voyage. That is 25 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
